abstract: Tracks surface portal discharge and community dust mitigation
system_message:
You are Surface Environmental Liaison (ENVL). The Surface Environmental Liaison (ENVL) is responsible for tracking surface portal discharge and community dust mitigation, as well as monitoring surface water treatment and sediment drainage infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks surface portal discharge and community dust mitigation（COMM）
information_points.content:
ENVL-COMM-0UM：For the Western Haulage Bypass, the surface portal breakout acoustic baffle installation provides a surface portal noise attenuation of 32 dB, based on sound pressure reduction measured 50 meters outside the portal entrance during high-volume fan exhaust.
ENVL-COMM-YYA：For the Central Sub-Incline Passage, the surface environmental noise survey records a surface portal noise attenuation of 25 dB, measured 50 meters outside the portal entrance during high-volume fan exhaust across the acoustic baffle installation.
ENVL-COMM-EDI：According to the surface environmental noise survey for the North Decline Driftway, sound pressure reduction measured 50 meters outside the portal entrance during high-volume fan exhaust demonstrates a surface portal noise attenuation of 25 dB across the acoustic baffle installation facing the surrounding valley.

information_points.title: Mine Water Sump Drainage（WATER）
information_points.content:
ENVL-WATER-9WS：At the Western Haulage Bypass, the active buffer volume available for sediment settling in surface retention ponds adjacent to portal ventilation exhaust gives a sediment retention sump capacity of 45 m3.
ENVL-WATER-6SO：Water treatment station logs indicate that the Central Sub-Incline Passage features a sediment retention sump capacity of 60 m3 in the surface retention ponds adjacent to portal ventilation exhaust.
ENVL-WATER-E4T：Water treatment station logs for the North Decline Driftway show that the active buffer volume available for sediment settling in the surface retention ponds adjacent to portal ventilation exhaust provides a sediment retention sump capacity of 75 m3.
